program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed ?? 4; const gravity = inputs.gravity ?? 9.8; const mass = inputs.mass ?? 1.0; const t = Math.max(0, time); const velocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const height = launchSpeed * t - 0.5 * gravity * t * t; const acceleration = -gravity; const force = mass * gravity; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); let motionState = "Rising"; if (Math.abs(velocity) < 0.05) { motionState = "At the top"; } else if (t > apexTime) { motionState = "Falling"; } if (height <= 0 && t > 0.1) { motionState = "Back at launch height"; } if (t === 0) { motionState = "Ready to toss"; } const maxH = Math.max(2.2, apexHeight * 1.3); const scaleY = (val) => 280 - (val / maxH) * 200; const ballY = scaleY(Math.max(0, height)); const leftLaneObjects = [...sdk.panel({ x: 20, y: 30, w: 280, h: 360, title: "The Motion", state: motionState })]; leftLaneObjects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", 160, ballY, 24, { role: "output" })); leftLaneObjects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: 190, y: ballY }, { value: velocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, label: "v" })); leftLaneObjects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: 215, y: ballY }, { value: acceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, label: "a" })); leftLaneObjects.push(...sdk.callout(235, ballY - 20, ["v: " + velocity.toFixed(2) + " m/s", "a: " + acceleration.toFixed(1) + " m/s^2", "Fg: " + force.toFixed(1) + " N"], { id: "callout.toss" })); const plotPoints = []; const dt = apexTime * 2 / 20; for (let i = 0; i <= 20; i++) { const ti = i * dt; const vi = launchSpeed - gravity * ti; const px = 340 + (ti / (apexTime * 2)) * 260; const py = 240 - ((vi + 5.5) / 11) * 180; plotPoints.push([px, py]); } const plotObject = sdk.plot("plot.vt", { x: 320, y: 30, w: 300, h: 360, axes: { x: { label: "Time (s)", min: 0, max: Math.max(1.8, apexTime * 2), unit: "s" }, y: { label: "Velocity (m/s)", min: -5.5, max: 5.5, unit: "m/s" } }, series: [{ label: "v(t)", kind: "line", points: sdk.sample((ti) => launchSpeed - gravity * ti, 0, Math.max(1.66, apexTime * 2), 20).map(([ti, vi]) => ({ x: 340 + (ti / 1.8) * 260, y: 210 - (vi / 5.5) * 150 })) }] }); const objects = [...leftLaneObjects, plotObject]; return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects: objects, readouts: [{ id: "velocity", value: Number(velocity.toFixed(2)) }, { id: "acceleration", value: Number(acceleration.toFixed(1)) }, { id: "force", value: Number(force.toFixed(1)) }, { id: "motionState", value: motionState }] }, quantities: { velocity, height, acceleration, force, apexTime, apexHeight, launchSpeed, gravity, mass } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero, but acceleration and gravitational force remain constant.
manifest.description: Two side-by-side views show a ball tossed vertically on the left and its velocity-time graph on the right. Controls allow changing launch speed, gravity, and mass.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Compare readings near the top.
